description: Quality scoring rubric for the consulting profile — one entry per deliverable stage (1–6). Required sections are H2 headings of profiles/consulting/templates/stages/*.md.

quality_criteria.description: Every high-power stakeholder has a named engagement strategy
Steering committee has named members and a fixed cadence
Every KPI has a numeric baseline and target with dates

consistency_checks.description: RACI has exactly one Accountable per activity
Communication plan covers every quadrant of the power/interest grid

generation_batches.title: Stakeholders & governance
generation_batches.instruction: Name real stakeholder roles implied by the Stage 0 mandate, not generic placeholders. Every high-power stakeholder needs a specific engagement strategy. Steering committee needs named members and a fixed cadence.

generation_batches.title: RACI, success criteria & communication
generation_batches.instruction: Use the stakeholders and governance above. RACI must have exactly one Accountable per activity. KPIs need numeric baselines and targets with dates. Communication plan must cover every quadrant of the power/interest grid.

generation_batches.title: Sign-off
generation_batches.instruction: Use the complete document above as context.

stage2.name: Current State Diagnostic & Root Cause Analysis

quality_criteria.description: Every Stage 1 KPI has a numeric baseline or an explicit data gap
Every finding cites evidence and a quantified impact
Every root cause explains at least one finding and has a confidence level
Value at stake is numeric with a basis of estimate

consistency_checks.description: Systems are described as AS-IS context only; no solution or vendor language
KPI Baseline covers the KPIs defined in Stage 1

generation_batches.title: Operating model & KPI baseline
generation_batches.instruction: Describe the AS-IS operating model as pure context — no solution or vendor language (this engagement never proposes systems). Every KPI from Stage 1 needs a numeric baseline or an explicit stated data gap, not a vague estimate.

generation_batches.title: Root causes & value at stake
generation_batches.instruction: Use the operating model and KPI baseline above. Every finding needs cited evidence and a quantified impact. Every root cause must explain a specific finding and carry a confidence level, not a single surface-level guess. Value at stake must be numeric with a stated basis of estimate.

generation_batches.title: Sign-off
generation_batches.instruction: Use the complete document above as context.

quality_criteria.description: At least three options plus a do-nothing baseline are evaluated
Criteria weights sum to 100 and each has a stated source
Recommendation names one OPT-NN and states its weighted score against the runner-up
Risks of inaction are quantified with a timeframe

consistency_checks.description: Every option references the Stage 2 root causes it addresses
Options describe business change, not system implementation

generation_batches.title: Options & evaluation criteria
generation_batches.instruction: Generate at least three real options plus an explicit do-nothing baseline, each addressing specific Stage 2 root causes — describe business change, never system implementation or vendor selection. Criteria weights must sum to 100 with a stated source for each.

generation_batches.title: Evaluation & recommendation
generation_batches.instruction: Score every option (including do-nothing) from the batch above against the stated criteria. The recommendation must name one OPT-NN and state its weighted score against the runner-up, with an explicit rationale. Quantify risks of inaction with a timeframe.

generation_batches.title: Sign-off
generation_batches.instruction: Use the complete document above as context.

quality_criteria.description: Every roadmap phase has a dated, measurable milestone and an owner
No system implementation or vendor selection is proposed

consistency_checks.description: Target Operating Model names the implemented OPT-NN from Stage 3
Every target-state dimension maps to Stage 2 root causes
Change plan covers every high-power stakeholder group from Stage 1

generation_batches.title: Target operating model
generation_batches.instruction: Name the specific OPT-NN recommended in Stage 3 and design the target state that implements it. Every target-state dimension must map to a Stage 2 root cause — no system implementation or vendor selection.

generation_batches.title: Roadmap & change management
generation_batches.instruction: Use the target operating model above. Every roadmap phase needs a dated, measurable milestone and a named owner. The change plan must cover every high-power stakeholder group from Stage 1.

generation_batches.title: Sign-off
generation_batches.instruction: Use the complete document above as context.

quality_criteria.description: Every Critical/High risk has a named individual owner and a dated mitigation
Readiness is scored per stakeholder group
Escalation triggers are numeric or observable

consistency_checks.description: Steering committee named here matches Stage 1
Adoption risks reference the Stage 4 change plan

generation_batches.title: Risk register & readiness
generation_batches.instruction: Adoption risks must reference the Stage 4 change plan, not generic implementation risks. Readiness must be scored per stakeholder group from Stage 1, not a single blanket score.

generation_batches.title: Governance & ownership
generation_batches.instruction: Use the risk register above. The steering committee named here must match Stage 1. Every Critical/High risk needs a named individual owner and a dated mitigation; escalation triggers must be numeric or observable.

generation_batches.title: Sign-off
generation_batches.instruction: Use the complete document above as context.

quality_criteria.description: Costs and benefits are numeric with a basis of estimate
ROI, payback and NPV are stated with assumptions and a sensitivity
Tracker has a named client-side owner, cadence and corrective-action trigger

consistency_checks.description: Every benefit traces to a Stage 2 root cause and a Stage 1 KPI
Total cost is compared to the Stage 0 budget ceiling

generation_batches.title: Business case
generation_batches.instruction: Every benefit must trace to a Stage 2 root cause and a Stage 1 KPI — no invented savings. Costs and benefits need a stated basis of estimate. Total cost must be compared explicitly against the Stage 0 budget ceiling.

generation_batches.title: Realization tracking
generation_batches.instruction: Use the business case above. ROI, payback and NPV need stated assumptions and a sensitivity range. The tracker needs a named client-side owner, a review cadence, and a corrective-action trigger.

generation_batches.title: Sign-off
generation_batches.instruction: Use the complete document above as context.
